body: DEPENDENCY CLARIFICATION for the C1 topology: core has no dependency on proposition, acquire, story, or document. Therefore C1 NarrativeSourceAtlas must be proposition-agnostic: source-unit IDs, substrate/axis membership, EvidenceSupport, ordering/containment where substrate-defined, and checked conformance identity only. It may be generic over a caller-owned payload only if equality, validation, and source identity do not inspect that payload; the safer first slice is no semantic payload at all. PropositionEvidence and PropositionChart attachment remain in document/compiler migration at D1. C1 must not invert the existing build graph to make the future compiler API look finished early.
